research_scope: Two-stage multimodal retrieval over paired chest X-rays and reports

input_protocol.candidate_pool: Union of the 600 development and 120 confirmation cases
input_protocol.view_policy: Encode each available projection independently, average normalized embeddings per case, then L2-normalize
input_protocol.missing_image_policy: Exclude before encoding only if no declared image matches the verified official archive

reranking.score_normalization: Independent min-max normalization of BM25 and image cosine scores within each query shortlist
reranking.zero_range_policy: Return zeros for a modality whose shortlist scores have range <= 1e-12
reranking.outside_shortlist_policy: Append candidates 101-720 in their original BM25 order
reranking.tie_break: Descending fused score then ascending case_id

hypotheses: The paired shortlist reranker improves confirmation MRR over report-only BM25.
The paired shortlist reranker improves confirmation Hit@1 and downstream Token-F1 over report-only BM25.
Constrained image reranking is more effective than unrestricted global rank fusion.
claim_limits: This is paired evidence retrieval, not diagnosis of a new patient image.
The confirmation cohort is from IU-Xray and is not an external dataset.
Automatic report-derived QA is not radiologist validation.
Clinical deployment and medical-device use are out of scope.
